blindReviewDeclaration: Fresh v2s-rooted independent review. Findings and NO_GO verdict were formed from frozen inputs, production source, fresh commands, and evidence before reading any author self-review, author disposition, or Claude review. No such material was read.
commandsRun: scripts/memory/query --task-kind review --domain platform --consumer-face backend --owner platform --impact governance --trigger task-start
scripts/context/recall-memory --task-kind review --domain platform --consumer-face backend --owner platform --impact governance --trigger task-start

findings.title: B.3 的 12 个 ACTIVE ArchUnit 条目没有对应的真实强制面
findings.evidence: standards matrix binds B.3.N01-N12 to BackendModuleBoundariesTest, but that class has only framework-free domain, organization-to-workspace-internals, and TDP-package rules. It has no assertions for command REQUIRED transaction, coordinator zero assets, repository/domain visibility across all modules, listener whitelist, API type boundary, or dependency registry three-way reconciliation. scripts/check/backend-boundaries only checks file/registry existence, TDP source absence, and token absence.
findings.impact: R4 falsely marks the backend architecture denominator ACTIVE; prohibited production boundary regressions can pass the claimed gate suite.
findings.smallerRepair: Implement only the missing mechanical ArchUnit/registry assertions and a production-path red mutation per asserted rule; otherwise reclassify rows to an explicit review checklist instead of ACTIVE.

findings.title: 数据库、query 与 rollback 证明不足，却覆盖了 21 个 ACTIVE 条目
findings.evidence: cli.mjs database() reads one fixed migration and checks only two DDL token families plus two schema names; budget() checks only SELECT * and FOR UPDATE in libraries/backend, and query-boundaries is the same budget action. R4DatabaseBoundariesTest has three test cases (composite FK, stale CAS, RLS) and no rollback/transaction assertion; its AfterAll Flyway clean is teardown, not rollback proof. It does not prove migration history/version/order, all owner DDL/FK rules, DML prohibition, security predicates for task reads, or database-operation budget.
findings.impact: The matrix's B.2/B.6 ACTIVE classification and the closure evidence claim of rollback/query coverage are materially stronger than the executable proof.
findings.smallerRepair: Add narrowly scoped validators/tests for each claimed mechanical fact, including an asserted rollback negative; move non-mechanical rules to review rather than expanding a text scanner.

findings.title: 安全和 OpenAPI gate 未执行承诺的 server-route/consumer-face 三方对账
findings.evidence: security() only looks for X-Edge-Principal|edge text in EdgeContextVerifier, x-consumer-faces text in the OpenAPI file, and one operations-admin sentence. openapi() only runs generator --check and requires a nonempty generated route registry. Neither compares controller mappings with the generated registry/OpenAPI nor executes forged/direct-request behavior. The controller is a separate production surface with mappings, but no validator reads it.
findings.impact: An extra or missing server route, or a route that bypasses the intended security path, can remain green while D.2 and the security denominator are declared ACTIVE.
findings.smallerRepair: Derive controller route metadata mechanically and compare it to the existing OpenAPI/registry source of truth; keep authorization semantics in focused tests/review rather than token matching.

findings.title: affected-L2 和 closure evidence 没有证明实际受影响测试选择
findings.evidence: scripts/verify calls scripts/check/affected-l2 with no --changed input, producing SELECTED=REGISTRY_ONLY. The closure evidence nevertheless reports L3 PASS as a selected backend plus two-admin test set. The registry returns path strings only and the checker neither derives changed surfaces nor verifies/runs the selected targets.
findings.impact: R4's claimed deterministic L2 selection is a registry-presence check, not a mapping/evidence mechanism; a migration change can be accepted without its affected suite being selected.
findings.smallerRepair: Make verify consume an explicit bounded changed-surface input (or record a deliberate ALL_R3_L2 fallback), validate selected target existence, execute or explicitly hand off the selected tests, and record that exact selection in evidence.

findings.title: R4 closure evidence is hash-stale for scripts/verify
findings.evidence: doc/evidence/platform/r4-closure-readiness-evidence.json records verify=722e5de7..., while fresh SHA-256 of scripts/verify is 92b8a6c9.... The other four listed source hashes match.
findings.impact: The closure packet cannot bind the PASS result to the reviewed verify bytes, so it is not valid immutable evidence for R4 acceptance.
findings.smallerRepair: Regenerate the evidence only after the reviewed verify implementation and fresh command results are final; retain the exact current hashes.

findings.title: 日志与 retirement validators are materially narrower than their declared rules
findings.evidence: logging() rejects only console.log lines containing a small secret-word set, whereas the frozen logging standard prohibits free backend loggers, raw request/response and multiple sensitive values, and requires structured context. retirement() only rejects Kafka and new WebClient; it does not check zero registration/route/generated-symbol/reference replacement maps.
findings.impact: The gates may pass prohibited logger or retired-topology residue and should not be presented as full enforcement.
findings.smallerRepair: Use finite, explicit mechanical denominators for allowed logging entrypoints and approved retirement replacements; leave semantic log-quality judgment to the review checklist.

findings.title: Testcontainers cleanup is only asserted on a successful Gradle path
findings.evidence: verify.mjs disables Ryuk, hard-codes TESTCONTAINERS_DOCKER_SOCKET_OVERRIDE=/var/run/docker.sock for every unix Docker host, and invokes residual-resource inspection only after gradle exits zero. This fresh run did execute against Colima and left zero labelled resources, but a failed test bypasses the cleanup inspection entirely.
findings.impact: A green run has cleanup evidence; failed dynamic runs do not have the promised independent cleanup disposition, and the hard-coded override is not derived from the active Unix socket.
findings.smallerRepair: Preserve the derived Docker endpoint and execute bounded residual inspection in finally for both pass and fail paths, reporting cleanup separately without widening runtime scope.

findings.title: Fresh dynamic execution was real, but does not cure the coverage findings
findings.evidence: JUnit XML records 4 ArchUnit and 3 R4 database tests with skipped=0; Testcontainers logs show PostgreSQL 16 started, Flyway migrated one migration, and fresh docker label inspection returned no residual resources.
findings.impact: This validates the existence of a real disposable test run only; it cannot validate unimplemented rule assertions.

verdict.summary: Five M findings invalidate the claimed R4 machine-enforcement denominator and current closure evidence. Fresh verify PASS and clean successful Testcontainers execution are insufficient for acceptance.
